results.content:
Based on 201 reviews

Review Cloudflare?

Reviewers mostly see Cloudflare as a dependable way to make sites faster and safer, with especially strong praise for DNS, CDN, caching, DDoS protection, and easy setup. Users repeatedly say it improves load times and keeps sites online, while several also note that its breadth of features can make advanced configuration confusing or hard to learn. Founders of Magic Patterns, Context.dev, and IFTTT also highlight its role as core infrastructure for hosting, API protection, and DNS/SSL reliability.

No egress fees. S3-compatible API. That's it.

If you're still paying for S3 egress, you're burning money for no reason.
